articles.title: Qualcomm Waits on a Jury: Arm Has a $443 Million Customer on the Line
articles.description: Qualcomm (QCOM:NASDAQ) will have to wait until at least Tuesday, October 13, to learn whether a jury agrees that Arm Holdings (ARM:NASDAQ) broke their licensing agreements. Jurors in Wilmington, Delaware, deliberated for about four hours on Friday, October 9, without reaching a verdict, Reuters reported.

articles.title: Qualcomm (QCOM) Signs Broad Multi Year Patent Deal
articles.description: QUALCOMM (NasdaqGS:QCOM) and Huawei have entered a multi-year cross-license agreement covering 5G, AI, compute, and networking technologies. The deal includes Qualcomm's purchase of select Huawei patents, which remains subject to regulatory approval in the United States. This is the first broad cross-license between Huawei and Qualcomm for 5G and emerging technologies, potentially affecting future royalty structures for both firms.
